title: Conversation context visibility in the interface
description: Show retrieval progress through message.status events, a composer footnote when earlier messages are summarized with a popover showing the summary, and context usage in the answer details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a streamed answer, when retrieval and generation progress, then the stage is shown and announced to assistive technology.
Given a summarized conversation, when viewing the composer, then the summary note appears and opens the current summary.
test_cases: Vitest/RTL and Playwright coverage of status events and the summary popover.
verification:
Agent H: SSE message.status stages shown and announced (ConversationPane.status.test.tsx); the memory footnote opens the current summary and names the model (memory-note.test.tsx).
Live: answers streamed planning, retrieving, reranking and generating; Details showed 'Context: 5,665 of 1,050,000 tokens' for a request capped at 64,000, so d9155cd adds ContextUsage.input_budget and counts against it (red: AttributeError for input_budget; the Details test lacked 'Context: 2,900 of 3,072 tokens').
Final: frontend check 449 passed and build passed; browser 12/12. Live (ara-rag-live, real OpenAI key, Attention and RAG papers): see the journal entry 'Wave 3 merge, Wave 4 integration and live verification'.
